ngos.title: First Need
ngos.statement: The owner needs a pocket CW handheld for the 2 m band.
ngos.rationale: Fixture Need one; a second Need is seeded below (T-21).

ngos.title: Second Need (seeded)
ngos.statement: A second Need is seeded to break the one-Need rule.
ngos.rationale: Seeded defect for T-21 (exactly one Need).

ngos.title: Goal with an Objective as parent (seeded)
ngos.statement: The goal points at an objective instead of the Need.
ngos.rationale: Seeded defect for T-21 (Goal parent is the Need).

ngos.title: Objective with the Need as parent (seeded)
ngos.statement: The objective points at the Need instead of a Goal and is Baselined but cited by nothing.
ngos.rationale: Seeded defect for T-21 (Objective parent is a Goal); cited by MOE-002 so that only NGO-005 is the uncovered Objective.

ngos.title: Baselined Objective that nothing cites (seeded)
ngos.statement: The objective is Baselined but no SYS requirement and no MOE cites it.

moes.title: Unresolved links (seeded)
moes.statement: An MOE whose NGO and OPS links do not resolve.
moes.success_criterion: Never met; seeded defect for T-21.
moes.rationale: Seeded defect for T-21 (ngo_ids and ops_ids resolution).

moes.title: No scenario (seeded)
moes.statement: An MOE with no scenario while the ConOps exists.
moes.success_criterion: Never met; seeded warning for T-20.
moes.rationale: Seeded warning for T-20 (MOE without ops_ids).

constraints.title: Part 97 applies
constraints.statement: The radio is operated under 47 CFR Part 97 by licensed operators.

constraints.title: Duplicate id (seeded)
